text: An army of volunteers cleaned the whole beach.
translation: 一大批志愿者清理了整片海滩。
note: 军队，引申义 —— 一大批人为同一目的聚集。线索是 volunteers，不是军事语境。

text: The army marched through the capital city.
note: 军队，陆军。线索是 marched 与 capital city（首都/首都军区），军事语境明确。

text: He joined the army when he was eighteen.
note: 军队。线索是 joined + 十八岁，是入伍的说法。

text: The army of ants marched across the path.
note: 军队，引申义 —— 一大批。线索是 ants（蚂蚁），说明这是「大批」而非军队。

text: A huge army of fans waited outside the stadium.
translation: 一大批球迷在场馆外等候。
note: 军队，引申义。线索是 fans + waited outside stadium，人群而非部队。

text: He kept an army of assistants at his company.
translation: 他在公司里配了一批助手。
note: 大批人（雇员）。线索是 assistants + at his company，是雇员群体。

text: A whole army of workers joined the strike.
translation: 整整一大批工人加入了罢工。
note: 大批人。线索是 workers + strike（罢工），是劳工群体。

text: She has an army of siblings to support her.
translation: 她有一大群兄弟姐妹支持她。
note: 大批人。线索是 siblings，是家族群体。

text: The army of bicycles filled the parking lot.
translation: 大批自行车塞满了停车场。
note: 大批人/物。线索是 bicycles，说明是「大批自行车」而非人群。

text: Facing the task, he felt like an army of one.
translation: 面对这项任务，他觉得自己孤军奋战。
note: 大批人（引申为一大群）。线索是 like an army of one（孤军一人），强调「一个人也算一支队伍」。
